title: Customer Care Credit Schedule: Correction Credit on Charged Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
**Rule.** The correction credit of a correction of a charged Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee is read from the assessment's refund and dispute history: a charge that already carries a level-difference refund takes the repeat-correction credit; a charge with no level-difference refund that the rider has disputed takes the disputed-correction credit; any other charge takes no correction credit.

| Assessment history | Correction credit |
|---|---|
| a level-difference refund (a partial refund entry) is already on the assessment ledger | 10% (repeat correction) |
| no level-difference refund, and the rider has disputed the charge | 5% (disputed correction) |
| neither | none |

- **Level-difference refund** — a partial refund entry booked on the assessment ledger.
- **Disputed** — the assessment carries a dispute filed date.

The correction credit is a percentage reduction of the fee as it then stands, applied immediately before the final rounding.

**Questions on the schedule**

*A charge that was disputed and also already carries a level-difference refund?* It takes the 10% repeat-correction credit; the 5% applies only where there is no level-difference refund.

*A charge that was never disputed and has no partial refund on its ledger?* No correction credit.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A disputed charge with no partial refund on its ledger and a fee of $80.00 standing before the credit: reduced by 5%, that is $76.00.
